## Story DD Coverage
- DD1+DD3 (documented coverage): the 3-guard refusal + --force bypass model needs maintainer-facing documentation.

## Implementation Notes

Update `plugins/dso/docs/WORKTREE-GUIDE.md`:

1. New section: `### Worktree removal safety guards`
   - List the 3 guards: protected branch, uncommitted/unpushed, open PR with CI.
   - Document the 3-tier open-PR fallback chain and the rationale (gh/cli #6462 fork-PR miss).
   - Document the --force bypass semantics: guards still run, messages still print, exit code becomes 0.
2. Cross-link to lib/worktree-removal-guards.sh.
3. State the TOCTOU mitigation (double-check pattern) and the residual window limitation.

Doc-router Gate 2 fired (existing reference doc). Emit DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION at commit.

| `plugins/dso/docs/WORKTREE-GUIDE.md` | modify | n/a (instruction file) | still-valid |

- [ ] Documents 3-tier fallback rationale
  Verify: grep -qE 'gh.*pr.*list.*--head|fork.*PR|6462' plugins/dso/docs/WORKTREE-GUIDE.md
